articles.summary: Entertainment technology company and studio Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), has today announced new deals with streaming services Dropout and Eternal Family . The two companies have licensed premium content from Cineverse's library. Spanning tens of thousands of titles, this library has a valuation of approximately $45 million and spans TV shows and feature films across genres with powerful fandoms, from horror to anime to documentaries to sports and to indie films. Comedy streaming service Dropout has licensed Hundreds of Beavers , which is now available via SVOD at watch.dropout.tv . The wildly successful indie hit follows the story of a drunken applejack salesman who must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers. LA Times , The Washington Post and AV Club all included it as one of the best films of 2024 and Letterboxd named it 2024's Highest Rated Comedy. Eternal Family , the "hidden-gem video store," has licensed 10 titles
articles.title: Cineverse Licenses Indie Hit 'Hundreds of Beavers' to Dropout SVOD Comedy Platform, Plus 10 Titles to Eternal Family

articles.summary: Former Apple global infrastructure leader, technology founder behind Cineverse's Matchpoint® platform, and AI infrastructure entrepreneur nominated to join the Board as Cineverse advances its next phase of technology and platform innovation. Corp. (Nasdaq: CNVS) ("Cineverse" or the "Company"), an entertainment technology company and studio, announced the nomination for election to its Board of Directors of Dr. Samrat Ganguly at Cineverse's upcoming annual meeting of stockholders on December 8, 2026. Dr. Ganguly spent more than a decade at Apple, most recently as head of the Company's global network infrastructure organization, where he was responsible for the architecture, engineering and operations of the network and security infrastructure behind iCloud, Apple TV, the App Store and the broader Apple services ecosystem. articles.title: Cineverse Nominates Dr. Samrat Ganguly for Election to Board of Directors

articles.summary: IndiCue , less than nine months after being acquired by entertainment technology company and studio Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), is generating strong revenue and signing new customers. This includes today's announcement that IndiCue and performance advertising agency Cannella Media DTC are working together to bring a performance-driven approach and direct buying path into streaming inventory. Through this partnership, IndiCue will provide Cannella Media with a demand-side platform (DSP) to power Performance+, Cannella's pay-for-performance DTC CTV business and facilitate direct, programmatic media buying. Cannella helps brands grow through accountable advertising across television, streaming, digital, and audio. Drawing on more than $8 billion in proprietary media marketplace data, Cannella provides media buying, analytics, creative, and campaign execution for advertisers and agencies. articles.title: IndiCue Brings its DSP to Cannella Media, Powering its Performance+ CPA-Based CTV Business and Direct Programming Media Buying

articles.summary: In June, entertainment technology company and studio Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS) recorded its highest-ever gross revenue from social video in a single month, up 82% from the biggest month in 2025. Now a multi-million dollar business, revenue from video across YouTube, Facebook, and Twitch is up 55% year-over-year (January through June). This double-digit growth comes as the company announces two new launches: a new Yu-Gi-Oh! live stream on the iconic anime series' official YouTube channel , and a Spanish-language version of Dog Whisperer with Cesar Millan ( El Encantador del Perros con Cesar Millan ) on YouTube and Facebook . "With YouTube, month in and month out, the TV platform audiences spend the most time with, according to Nielsen's The Gauge™ , it's essential for us to connect with audiences there, in order to continue to grow the reach of our streaming brands. YouTube and other social video have become a strong revenue-driver for our business," said Cineverse Senior Vice
articles.title: Cineverse Building Upon Social Video Revenue Growth with a First-Time Spanish-Language Dog Whisperer Channel on YouTube + a Yu-Gi-Oh! Live Stream

articles.summary: Jason Voorhees is returning to the big screen. Horror, Inc., under the leadership of the Barsamian family, today announced a new feature film slated for a global theatrical release in 2027. Returning to the franchise's independent roots, the film is financed and produced by the Barsamians. CatchLight Studios is named as the production partner, with Cineverse (NASDAQ: CNVS) securing North America distribution rights, including theatrical. Arriving as the 13th feature film centered on the hockey-masked killer, this fresh entry welcomes a new generation of horror fans into the Jason Universe while delivering the practical kills and terror longtime Friday the 13th fans crave. To bring this long-awaited release to the big screen, the producers tapped legacy franchise director Steve Miner–who first put the machete in Jason's hands in Friday the 13th Part II and introduced the legendary hockey mask in Friday the 13th Part III –to direct the 2027 film from a script penned by emerging
articles.title: Jason Voorhees Heads Back to Theaters in Historic 13th Feature Film
